title: 'An Apology, on behalf of the French' — editorial essay film on French Theory
summary: A 3-minute voiceover essay (male, lightly French-accented English) built like an animated printed book: warm parchment pages, a thin page border with folio labels, a serif title stack, engraved-style portrait cards of thinkers, period etchings and maps, rubber-stamp labels, strikethrough word pairs and Venn diagrams. A karaoke subtitle box at the bottom highlights the spoken word in oxblood red. It turns dark (near-black page) for the conclusion's 'EVERY HIERARCHY / SUSPECT' list. Slow, authoritative, documentary.
fit_reason: Content is political and off-brand, but the system (voiceover + karaoke subtitle box, serif editorial layout, cards that build a concept map, strike-through 'old way vs new way' pairs, stamped labels) is an excellent template for calm, credible long-form explainers.

palette.mood: warm parchment editorial with vignette and paper grain; oxblood red and ink-navy accents; dark near-black section for the climax

typography.display: high-contrast didone/transitional serif (Bodoni / Didot / Libre Caslon look) for titles; serif italic in ink-navy for subtitles ('French Theory'); condensed heavy sans in oxblood for one shock word (WOKEISM.); letter-spaced serif caps for labels and lists ('THE MEANING OF A TEXT', 'EVERY HIERARCHY'); typewriter slab for stamps
typography.case: title case serif, upper for labels/stamps
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: centred title stack at top, medium serif words beside portraits, small caption box at bottom
typography.notes: Folio-style micro labels in the page corners ('ON BEHALF OF THE FRENCH', 'PG. III'). Strike-through pairs: italic red word left (Rhizome, Nomad, Desire) vs struck grey word right (Tree, Settler, Law).

text_animation: shock word punches in with an ink-blot splash behind it (WOKEISM. at 15.8 s)
word struck through with a red line, new word appears below (Truth → POWER, The Author † → The Reader ♛)
list items appear one per sentence with a stamped label landing on the right (SUSPECT, OPPRESSIVE, VIOLENCE…)
rubber stamps slam in at a tilt (BETRAYAL, COMBINED, EXPORTED, POPULARIZED, UNREADABLE IN FRANCE)
captions: karaoke highlight — 2-line serif subtitle in a translucent cream box centred at the bottom; words already spoken in black, the current word in oxblood #922b2b, upcoming words in light grey
motion: portrait cards slide/fade into place and re-arrange into groups and family trees
dotted route draws across an antique map with a ship
Venn circles slide together and the overlap fills red
transitions: fade to blank parchment before a new chapter
page goes dark for the conclusion
graphic_elements: engraved portrait cards with name plate and dates
period etchings (Paris barricade, books, theatre, Yale), antique map

pacing.hold_time_s: 6-20 (one page per idea, builds within the page)

sound.music: soft background score under VO (assumed), -14 LUFS overall
sound.voiceover: yes: single male narrator, measured, essayistic
sound.sync: every word/visual build is locked to the narration

signature_moves: karaoke subtitle box with oxblood current word
parchment page with serif title stack and folio labels
strike-through word pairs (old idea vs new idea)
portrait/card system that rearranges into a concept map with stamps

best_segments.what: Title stack 'An Apology / French Theory' with karaoke subtitle, then the shock word slams in red with an ink splash.
Portrait card left; 'Truth' appears, gets struck through, POWER lands below, karaoke caption tracks the VO.
Rhizome/Tree, Nomad/Settler pairs build one per line: italic red vs struck grey.
Dark page: 'THEREFORE — EVERY HIERARCHY / EVERY INSTITUTION…' list with stamped verdicts landing on the right.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion driven by a word-timed transcript (whisper word timestamps). Parchment = CSS radial-gradient vignette + grain PNG. Cards = divs with sepia images. Karaoke = spans whose colour switches grey → red → black on word times. Strike = SVG line scaleX. Stamps = rotated bordered text with rough mask, scale 1.3→1 with a thud. Etchings via AI image (engraving style) or public-domain plates.
recreate.prompt: Editorial documentary explainer on warm parchment #eae3d5 with vignette and grain, thin page border with folio labels. Didone serif title stack, italic ink-navy #2b3566 subtitles, one oxblood #922b2b shock word. Portrait/feature cards that rearrange into a concept map, stamped labels, strike-through 'old vs new' word pairs. Bottom-centre karaoke subtitle box: spoken words black, current word oxblood, upcoming grey.
